id.description: The id of the Pay Method in the Tyro Connect system. This id can be specified in the Pay Request when making payments for the associated customer.

customerId.description: The id of the Customer in the Tyro Connect system linked to this Pay Method.

card.description: The card used by the Pay Method

brand.description: Card brand such as Visa or Mastercard

firstSixDigits.description: First six digits of the card number

lastFourDigits.description: Last four digits of the card number
